Sobre a vaga

Our client is urgently seeking a Software Engineer with strong front-end expertise and solid experience across Python, SQL, C#/.NET, and Azure. This is a hands-on role requiring the ability to contribute across UI and core application logic.

Candidates should be comfortable coding in Python during interviews and working across multiple technologies in a modern engineering environment.

This role is on a contractual-basis, fully remote, full-time hours Mon-Fri, 12 months contract, and with an immediate start date.

*This role also requires strong English fluency and excellent communication skills*

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain front-end applications using modern frameworks
  • Develop and support application logic using Python and C#/.NET
  • Write and optimize SQL queries
  • Work within Azure-based environments
  • Collaborate with team members to deliver high-quality software
  • Debug, test, and enhance existing systems

Required Qualifications

  • Strong front-end development experience (React or Angular preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with Python (must be able to code live)
  • Experience with C# / .NET
  • Solid SQL skills
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals
  • Strong English fluency and English communication skills

If this role aligns with you - or someone who you know is qualified - please attach your most updated CV/resume *with a good phone number to reach you at*. My colleague, Jordan, can send you a call and discuss the role in-length with you.

Best regards,

Brian from Pixie Services

Requisitos adicionados pelo anunciante da vaga

• Mais de 15 anos de experiência profissional com Python (Programming Language)

• Mais de 15 anos de experiência profissional com C#

• Mais de 15 anos de experiência profissional com Software Engineers

Founded in 2007, Pixie supplies SAP®, Salesforce®, Microsoft® and other IT consulting and recruitment services across all sectors of industry and throughout most geographical locations. We build long term, trust relationships with consultants and customers that are characterized by professionalism, two way communication and speed of response. We have a global network of experienced SAP and IT specialists that enable us to fulfill our partners needs worldwide. We offer Contract-based SAP® and IT Recruitment solutions, our team is dedicated to bringing to our partners the industry expertise, insight and resources to make their IT projects successful.
